html: שׁבט (√ of foll.; cf. Assyrian šabâṭu, smite, slay, šibṭu, rod, sceptre; NH שֵׁבֶט = BH, also שָׁבַט beat (denom.? so NöZMG xi (1886), 736, but too sceptical); Sab. סבטם rod, blow, Sab.Denkm.No. 21, l. 5; Aramaic שִׁבְטָא, ܫܰܒܛܳܐ = BH; loan-word in Egyptian demot. šbtë, pl.hierogl. ša-b-dï-y, WMMAs. u. Eur. 89; LewyFremdw. 122 cp. σπάθη).
